g.text: O(n log n) Fermat-Prime NTT RSA Factoring Circuits (rsa-ntt-factoring)
Exact 𝔽₆₅₅₃₇ (F₄ = 2¹⁶ + 1) NTT multiplier circuits from 24 bits through RSA-896 (2026 record) to RSA-280 & RSA-1024
(a) Exact 𝔽₆₅₅₃₇ Number Theoretic Transform (NTT) Factoring Pipeline (Zero Wraparound: max cₖ ≤ 28,800 < 65,537)
(b) Exact AIGER AND-Gate Scaling: O(n log n) 𝔽₆₅₅₃₇ NTT vs. O(n²) Wallace
Empirical crossover at B = 934 bits (just past RSA-896 record & RSA-280); NTT saves 391,627 ANDs at RSA-1024
